reason: We do library storytime, parks and church groups because they're free. $13 a visit is a lot when I'd be paying for two kids and still chasing my 4-year-old around instead of sitting with a coffee.
objection: Thirteen dollars plus a sibling fee every time, when the library and the park cost nothing. I'd still be up chasing my kid, so the coffee and the seat wouldn't really be for me.
would_change_my_mind: A visit price around $5 to $6, or a free-for-families day each week. I'd also need to know it's much better than the free stuff for my 10-month-old.
